purpose: UX-18/T20 verification-only: prove the existing eight pinned CC0 crop-photo pipeline renders locally and consistently before considering any replacement asset.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, section 5.4 and UX-18/T20.
requiredInvariants: No crop image, source URL, digest, license, runtime component or CSS is changed by this verification slice.
All eight crop categories load local WebP renditions from the existing build-time materialization contract.
Rendered crop images use 8:5 geometry, object-fit cover, one object-position rule and no per-image CSS filter.
Evidence is captured at 390 and 1280 for every crop in catalogue order with no whole-document horizontal overflow.
Automated geometry does not substitute for visual review of crop/scale/colour-temperature consistency; UX-18 stays open if screenshots remain inconsistent.
